answers.comment: Nothing in koa extends Application, so 0 subtypes is true, and the answer refuses to treat it as a negative. It also says 'it implements or extends 0', which is not true in fact (Application extends Emitter, an external class), but the UNKNOWN flag covers it.

findings: Library functions that share a local name with a method or getter in the same file are bound to that repository member with high confidence: vary, fresh, accepts and URL in lib/request.js and lib/response.js. 5 of the 30 sampled high edges are this error (all 43 high edges were not checked). The tool's own module-import logic does not see that 'const vary = require("vary")' makes the name a library function.
Both medium edges are wrong (new URL in response.js bound to the URL getter of request.js), and 2 of 3 low edges are wrong (ctx.onerror bound to Application.onerror instead of context.js onerror).

analyze_impact for 'respond' reports '0 indirect' callers and 'Certainty high' although the chain is cut at a callback reference (.then(handleResponse)); an agent reading it would believe the function has one caller and no test coverage.

Calls through 'this' inside object-literal methods are largely unbound: 14 of 31 sampled call sites had no edge (this.get x5, this.remove x3, this.has, this.set, four toJSON). The 4 toJSON sites are ambiguous, the rest unresolved; none was bound to a wrong target. Class-method calls through this (Application) were all bound.
A method shorthand inside an object literal given to Object.defineProperty (lib/application.js:37 'value') is extracted as a method definition and acts as a caller.
Only 48 CALLS edges exist in a 111-file project; 3,678 of 4,081 references are unresolved, 1,821 of them shown to leave the repository.
No EXTENDS edge for 'class Application extends Emitter' (correct, the target is outside the repository), and find_implementations says so as UNKNOWN rather than as an empty answer.

Definitions were the strong point: 107 of 107 expected definitions found, with getter/setter pairs and the module.exports object-literal forms all handled. The top-level-call limitation was not exercised in the sample.
not_done: Only 30 of 43 high edges, all 2 medium and all 3 low were judged; the other 13 high edges were not read.
No call site at module top level was in the first-8 sample, so resolved-but-no-edge was not measured for JavaScript.
The __tests__ directory was not used for definitions or recall; it contributes 2 of the 30 sampled high edges and 1 of the 3 low ones to the precision sample.
Hierarchy could not be measured: no supertype in the project has a repository target.
